info.title: charter
info.description: Charter turns an AI-authored, block-structured plan into a rich, reviewable deliverable a human annotates in place — the front door to the Guardrails pipeline.

x-inspectra.cliParsedDescription: Charter — visual, reviewable plans your agent drafts, annotated in place.

commands.name: export
commands.description: Export a Charter plan (.mdx) to one self-contained, offline HTML file.

commands.name: handoff
commands.description: Convert a reviewed Charter plan (.mdx) to plain-CommonMark handoff markdown for Guardrails.

commands.name: render
commands.description: Render a Charter plan (.mdx) to one portable HTML file.

commands.name: review
commands.description: Serve a Charter plan (.mdx) read-only over the loopback review server.
